name: zah-workshop
description: ZAH Workshop: a keynote that runs in a browser instead of a slide app. Eleven scenes of a fixed arc, every word from one content file, every colour from CSS variables.

scripts.demo: node bin/zah-workshop.js build examples/starter/content.json --assets examples/starter/assets --out dist/starter && node bin/zah-workshop.js build examples/zah/content.mjs --out dist/zah
